questions.question: During multiple PPO epochs on one rollout batch, what must remain fixed?
options: Only the clipping threshold; old probabilities can be recomputed from the candidate
The collected actions, return targets and behavior-policy log probabilities
questions.explanation: The probability ratio compares the changing candidate with the policy that actually generated the batch. Replacing its denominator destroys that comparison.
optionFeedback: The candidate policy changes during optimization; the collected actions and behavior log probabilities describe the fixed rollout.
Recomputing old probabilities with the updated policy destroys the importance ratio. Save them when the rollout is collected.
